title: Poisoning of Alexander Litvinenko
excerpt: Ex-FSB officer fatally poisoned with polonium-210 in London in 2006; a UK public inquiry found the FSB operation was probably approved by Putin.
excerptEs: Exagente del FSB envenenado con polonio-210 en Londres en 2006; una investigación pública británica concluyó que Putin probablemente aprobó la operación del FSB.

sources.title: The Litvinenko Inquiry: Report into the death of Alexander Litvinenko (Sir Robert Owen, HC 695, 21 January 2016)
